Messages.Author: Appolonius
Messages.Body:
Advanced Lambach's ability reads: "He can equip with an Eye of Hazimel
at no cost from your library as a +1 stealth action (shuffle
afterward)."

If this action is blocked, is the Eye burned, or do you not get to the
point of searching your library?

Thanks in advance!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The latter.
